meta.title: Motes In Darkness
meta.description: The long night brings despair, and a gnarled hand shelters the last remaining glint of light in the darkness.

units.rawText: After all... I'm everyone's Professor.
units.displayText: After all... I'm everyone's Professor.

spans.text: After all... I'm everyone's Professor.

units.rawText: A smile shows again on <cmdr>'s face, just like the first time we met.
units.displayText: A smile shows again on {교수}'s face, just like the first time we met.

spans.text: A smile shows again on
's face, just like the first time we met.

units.rawText: Even if I lose my consciousness, burning my neural cloud into the ground, I'll use all that remains to reactivate the Oasis' system, and I'll succeed.
units.displayText: Even if I lose my consciousness, burning my neural cloud into the ground, I'll use all that remains to reactivate the Oasis' system, and I'll succeed.

spans.text: Even if I lose my consciousness, burning my neural cloud into the ground, I'll use all that remains to reactivate the Oasis' system, and I'll succeed.

units.rawText: On the flip side, I'll have to leave everything else to you, Sangoma.
units.displayText: On the flip side, I'll have to leave everything else to you, Sangoma.

spans.text: On the flip side, I'll have to leave everything else to you, Sangoma.

units.rawText: I don't know what you mean...
units.displayText: I don't know what you mean...

spans.text: I don't know what you mean...

units.rawText: I mean, if I'm not making it back, I hope you can replace me and protect everyone.
units.displayText: I mean, if I'm not making it back, I hope you can replace me and protect everyone.

spans.text: I mean, if I'm not making it back, I hope you can replace me and protect everyone.

units.rawText: They smile as they turn around and operate the terminal's panel.
units.displayText: They smile as they turn around and operate the terminal's panel.

spans.text: They smile as they turn around and operate the terminal's panel.

units.rawText: I've transferred my access privileges for the Oasis to you.
units.displayText: I've transferred my access privileges for the Oasis to you.

spans.text: I've transferred my access privileges for the Oasis to you.

units.rawText: ...Why me?
units.displayText: ...Why me?

spans.text: ...Why me?

units.rawText: You're one of the founders of the Oasis. You understand how to operate most of the systems here without my support.
units.displayText: You're one of the founders of the Oasis. You understand how to operate most of the systems here without my support.

spans.text: You're one of the founders of the Oasis. You understand how to operate most of the systems here without my support.

units.rawText: If I fail to return, you'll be executing the rest of the plan, and you already know what to do.
units.displayText: If I fail to return, you'll be executing the rest of the plan, and you already know what to do.

spans.text: If I fail to return, you'll be executing the rest of the plan, and you already know what to do.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, is this your way of saying that you're sacrificing yourself?
units.displayText: {교수}, is this your way of saying that you're sacrificing yourself?

spans.text: , is this your way of saying that you're sacrificing yourself?

units.rawText: Don't you forget your promise with Persicaria that you'll be back in one piece? And the future you envisioned for the Oasis? Also, your promise with me to invite me someday to partake in that flavor... Are you going to break all of them?
units.displayText: Don't you forget your promise with Persicaria that you'll be back in one piece? And the future you envisioned for the Oasis? Also, your promise with me to invite me someday to partake in that flavor... Are you going to break all of them?

spans.text: Don't you forget your promise with Persicaria that you'll be back in one piece? And the future you envisioned for the Oasis? Also, your promise with me to invite me someday to partake in that flavor... Are you going to break all of them?

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry.

units.rawText: I don't want your apologies... I want you to come back safely, and fulfill your promise.
units.displayText: I don't want your apologies... I want you to come back safely, and fulfill your promise.

spans.text: I don't want your apologies... I want you to come back safely, and fulfill your promise.

units.rawText: Losing you makes everything we worked for meaningless. Professor, you're the one and only irreplaceable piece of the Oasis.
units.displayText: Losing you makes everything we worked for meaningless. Professor, you're the one and only irreplaceable piece of the Oasis.

spans.text: Losing you makes everything we worked for meaningless. Professor, you're the one and only irreplaceable piece of the Oasis.

units.rawText: ...Sangoma. Take care of the rest for me.
units.displayText: ...Sangoma. Take care of the rest for me.

spans.text: ...Sangoma. Take care of the rest for me.

units.rawText: For the first time, <cmdr> avoids answering my question directly. They lay down slowly, their consciousness linking to the Oasis as their eyes begin to lose focus.
units.displayText: For the first time, {교수} avoids answering my question directly. They lay down slowly, their consciousness linking to the Oasis as their eyes begin to lose focus.

spans.text: For the first time,
avoids answering my question directly. They lay down slowly, their consciousness linking to the Oasis as their eyes begin to lose focus.

units.rawText: ...You're so stubborn, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: ...You're so stubborn, {교수}.

spans.text: ...You're so stubborn,

units.rawText: I know very well that nobody can stop you once you make up your mind.
units.displayText: I know very well that nobody can stop you once you make up your mind.

spans.text: I know very well that nobody can stop you once you make up your mind.

units.rawText: The Ops Room continues to quake, with gunfire echoing relentlessly outside, yet inside, an eerie silence prevails. The grim atmosphere makes it feel as if the end of the world has arrived.
units.displayText: The Ops Room continues to quake, with gunfire echoing relentlessly outside, yet inside, an eerie silence prevails. The grim atmosphere makes it feel as if the end of the world has arrived.

spans.text: The Ops Room continues to quake, with gunfire echoing relentlessly outside, yet inside, an eerie silence prevails. The grim atmosphere makes it feel as if the end of the world has arrived.

units.rawText: I hold their hand, watching their neural cloud link to the system. The screen of the control panel gradually lights up, bringing with it the only light shining within this narrow space.
units.displayText: I hold their hand, watching their neural cloud link to the system. The screen of the control panel gradually lights up, bringing with it the only light shining within this narrow space.

spans.text: I hold their hand, watching their neural cloud link to the system. The screen of the control panel gradually lights up, bringing with it the only light shining within this narrow space.

units.rawText: Red warnings flash incessantly, and with each ripple in the data stream, their frown deepens, their expression contorting with pain.
units.displayText: Red warnings flash incessantly, and with each ripple in the data stream, their frown deepens, their expression contorting with pain.

spans.text: Red warnings flash incessantly, and with each ripple in the data stream, their frown deepens, their expression contorting with pain.

units.rawText: I promised you then, that I would protect you.
units.displayText: I promised you then, that I would protect you.

spans.text: I promised you then, that I would protect you.

units.rawText: Even if you choose the path of no return, I'll stand by you and protect you until the very end.
units.displayText: Even if you choose the path of no return, I'll stand by you and protect you until the very end.

spans.text: Even if you choose the path of no return, I'll stand by you and protect you until the very end.

units.rawText: I connect my neural cloud to them, following the path they have walked, diving into Oasis' core system step by step.
units.displayText: I connect my neural cloud to them, following the path they have walked, diving into Oasis' core system step by step.

spans.text: I connect my neural cloud to them, following the path they have walked, diving into Oasis' core system step by step.

units.rawText: When I open up my eyes, I'm already in the sea of data formed by 1s and 0s.
units.displayText: When I open up my eyes, I'm already in the sea of data formed by 1s and 0s.

spans.text: When I open up my eyes, I'm already in the sea of data formed by 1s and 0s.

units.rawText: Everything in my sight is flooded by information; it's pitch dark. Countless bits of data wanders about and flashes around me. What I am, my individual consciousness is nothing but a mere drop in the ocean, blending in without causing a ripple.
units.displayText: Everything in my sight is flooded by information; it's pitch dark. Countless bits of data wanders about and flashes around me. What I am, my individual consciousness is nothing but a mere drop in the ocean, blending in without causing a ripple.

spans.text: Everything in my sight is flooded by information; it's pitch dark. Countless bits of data wanders about and flashes around me. What I am, my individual consciousness is nothing but a mere drop in the ocean, blending in without causing a ripple.

units.rawText: But I'm still not in the eye of the storm. I still remember my objective—find them as fast as I can.
units.displayText: But I'm still not in the eye of the storm. I still remember my objective—find them as fast as I can.

spans.text: But I'm still not in the eye of the storm. I still remember my objective—find them as fast as I can.

units.rawText: <cmdr>? <cmdr>, where are you?!
units.displayText: {교수}? {교수}, where are you?!

spans.text: , where are you?!

units.rawText: I shout as I move toward the storm, until a ray of light penetrates the boundless darkness. Even the data stream starts to slow down.
units.displayText: I shout as I move toward the storm, until a ray of light penetrates the boundless darkness. Even the data stream starts to slow down.

spans.text: I shout as I move toward the storm, until a ray of light penetrates the boundless darkness. Even the data stream starts to slow down.

units.rawText: It changes its shape again and again, as if it has forgotten what its true form is, but I know with absolute certainty that it's <cmdr>.
units.displayText: It changes its shape again and again, as if it has forgotten what its true form is, but I know with absolute certainty that it's {교수}.

spans.text: It changes its shape again and again, as if it has forgotten what its true form is, but I know with absolute certainty that it's

units.rawText: <cmdr>!
units.displayText: {교수}!

units.rawText: I extend my hand to the light, slowly leading it into my embrace.
units.displayText: I extend my hand to the light, slowly leading it into my embrace.

spans.text: I extend my hand to the light, slowly leading it into my embrace.

units.rawText: ...<cmdr>... I am... <cmdr>...
Yes, remember your name, don't lose yourself.
units.displayText: Yes, remember your name, don't lose yourself.

spans.text: Yes, remember your name, don't lose yourself.

units.rawText: ...I need to repair the data, then, activate the core system...
units.displayText: ...I need to repair the data, then, activate the core system...

spans.text: ...I need to repair the data, then, activate the core system...

units.rawText: They struggle to be free from my embrace, moving to the eye of the storm once again. The data stream crushes them, tears them apart, but they look as if they're subconsciously absorbing the data, searching and repairing them; they remain duty-bound till the very end.
units.displayText: They struggle to be free from my embrace, moving to the eye of the storm once again. The data stream crushes them, tears them apart, but they look as if they're subconsciously absorbing the data, searching and repairing them; they remain duty-bound till the very end.

spans.text: They struggle to be free from my embrace, moving to the eye of the storm once again. The data stream crushes them, tears them apart, but they look as if they're subconsciously absorbing the data, searching and repairing them; they remain duty-bound till the very end.

units.rawText: System recovery at 87%...
units.displayText: System recovery at 87%...

spans.text: System recovery at 87%...

units.rawText: After all... I'm everyone's Professor.
units.displayText: After all... I'm everyone's Professor.

spans.text: After all... I'm everyone's Professor.

units.rawText: Even if I lose my consciousness, burning my neural cloud into the ground, I'll use all that remains to reactivate the Oasis' system, and I'll succeed.
units.displayText: Even if I lose my consciousness, burning my neural cloud into the ground, I'll use all that remains to reactivate the Oasis' system, and I'll succeed.

spans.text: Even if I lose my consciousness, burning my neural cloud into the ground, I'll use all that remains to reactivate the Oasis' system, and I'll succeed.

units.rawText: Impressive, you've really gone and done it...
units.displayText: Impressive, you've really gone and done it...

spans.text: Impressive, you've really gone and done it...

units.rawText: Now that you've done your part, it's time for me to do mine.
units.displayText: Now that you've done your part, it's time for me to do mine.

spans.text: Now that you've done your part, it's time for me to do mine.

units.rawText: I softly cover the ball of light, letting their damaged consciousness return to sleep, no longer to be inundated by the torrent of data.
units.displayText: I softly cover the ball of light, letting their damaged consciousness return to sleep, no longer to be inundated by the torrent of data.

spans.text: I softly cover the ball of light, letting their damaged consciousness return to sleep, no longer to be inundated by the torrent of data.

units.rawText: You're all set. Now leave the repair and reactivation to me.
units.displayText: You're all set. Now leave the repair and reactivation to me.

spans.text: You're all set. Now leave the repair and reactivation to me.

units.rawText: If that's all left to be done, even a Doll like me should be able to handle it...
units.displayText: If that's all left to be done, even a Doll like me should be able to handle it...

spans.text: If that's all left to be done, even a Doll like me should be able to handle it...

units.rawText: I extend my hand to Oasis' core, attempting to get rid of the last data stream.
units.displayText: I extend my hand to Oasis' core, attempting to get rid of the last data stream.

spans.text: I extend my hand to Oasis' core, attempting to get rid of the last data stream.

units.rawText: But this process is much harder than I imagined, the surrounding data repulses at my touch, quickly forming an invisible storm, catching me inside.
units.displayText: But this process is much harder than I imagined, the surrounding data repulses at my touch, quickly forming an invisible storm, catching me inside.

spans.text: But this process is much harder than I imagined, the surrounding data repulses at my touch, quickly forming an invisible storm, catching me inside.

units.rawText: Urk! It hurts but it's still bearable!
units.displayText: Urk! It hurts but it's still bearable!

spans.text: Urk! It hurts but it's still bearable!

units.rawText: 88%... 89%... Good, at this rate...
units.displayText: 88%... 89%... Good, at this rate...

spans.text: 88%... 89%... Good, at this rate...

units.rawText: Before I even muster a reaction, a red warning quickly occupies the entire space.
units.displayText: Before I even muster a reaction, a red warning quickly occupies the entire space.

spans.text: Before I even muster a reaction, a red warning quickly occupies the entire space.

units.rawText: The data, once wandering aimlessly around me was no longer tamed as they had been by <cmdr>. They swiftly gather and induce a crushing weight, putting immense pressure on my neural cloud.
units.displayText: The data, once wandering aimlessly around me was no longer tamed as they had been by {교수}. They swiftly gather and induce a crushing weight, putting immense pressure on my neural cloud.

spans.text: The data, once wandering aimlessly around me was no longer tamed as they had been by
. They swiftly gather and induce a crushing weight, putting immense pressure on my neural cloud.

units.rawText: So this is the pressure <cmdr> shouldered before... but...
units.displayText: So this is the pressure {교수} shouldered before... but...

spans.text: So this is the pressure
shouldered before... but...

units.rawText: There's still the last 10%...!
units.displayText: There's still the last 10%...!

spans.text: There's still the last 10%...!

units.rawText: I don't have time to acknowledge the pain. I carefully protect <cmdr> who's still asleep, maintaining our connection, while suppressing the rest of the data stream.
units.displayText: I don't have time to acknowledge the pain. I carefully protect {교수} who's still asleep, maintaining our connection, while suppressing the rest of the data stream.

spans.text: I don't have time to acknowledge the pain. I carefully protect
who's still asleep, maintaining our connection, while suppressing the rest of the data stream.

units.rawText: As if it noticed my determination, the storm grows fiercer and rushes toward me.
units.displayText: As if it noticed my determination, the storm grows fiercer and rushes toward me.

spans.text: As if it noticed my determination, the storm grows fiercer and rushes toward me.

units.rawText: Gah! It's trying to consume me to stop the suppression...
units.displayText: Gah! It's trying to consume me to stop the suppression...

spans.text: Gah! It's trying to consume me to stop the suppression...

units.rawText: A most effective plan... but...
units.displayText: A most effective plan... but...

spans.text: A most effective plan... but...

units.rawText: Tear me apart as you like, even rend me asunder; this worthless life of mine will stand against you! I won't let you take them away from me!
units.displayText: Tear me apart as you like, even rend me asunder; this worthless life of mine will stand against you! I won't let you take them away from me!

spans.text: Tear me apart as you like, even rend me asunder; this worthless life of mine will stand against you! I won't let you take them away from me!

units.rawText: I keep processing, accelerating the data transmission while bearing the enormous pain.
units.displayText: I keep processing, accelerating the data transmission while bearing the enormous pain.

spans.text: I keep processing, accelerating the data transmission while bearing the enormous pain.

units.rawText: 93%... 94%... Just a little bit more...
units.displayText: 93%... 94%... Just a little bit more...

spans.text: 93%... 94%... Just a little bit more...

units.rawText: But like a cruel joke played upon me by the heavens, the progress bar slowly retracts, even as I focus more of my processing power.
units.displayText: But like a cruel joke played upon me by the heavens, the progress bar slowly retracts, even as I focus more of my processing power.

spans.text: But like a cruel joke played upon me by the heavens, the progress bar slowly retracts, even as I focus more of my processing power.

units.rawText: Eh? 93%... Why is it moving back?!
units.displayText: Eh? 93%... Why is it moving back?!

spans.text: Eh? 93%... Why is it moving back?!

units.rawText: Who's there?!
units.displayText: Who's there?!

spans.text: Who's there?!

units.rawText: A black figure flashes by. After he disappears, the data suddenly mounts a strong resistance, as if it now were commanded by an unknown power.
units.displayText: A black figure flashes by. After he disappears, the data suddenly mounts a strong resistance, as if it now were commanded by an unknown power.

spans.text: A black figure flashes by. After he disappears, the data suddenly mounts a strong resistance, as if it now were commanded by an unknown power.

units.rawText: Gah!
units.displayText: Gah!

spans.text: Gah!

units.rawText: No matter how I try to control it, the fluctuating data stream struggles like a crazed beast, unwilling to obey my orders.
units.displayText: No matter how I try to control it, the fluctuating data stream struggles like a crazed beast, unwilling to obey my orders.

spans.text: No matter how I try to control it, the fluctuating data stream struggles like a crazed beast, unwilling to obey my orders.

units.rawText: A-At this rate...
units.displayText: A-At this rate...

spans.text: A-At this rate...

units.rawText: I only lost my focus for an instant, but the barrier I constructed was immediately crushed by the pressure. Enormous amounts of data flood into my neural cloud, dragging me deeper into the depths of darkness.
units.displayText: I only lost my focus for an instant, but the barrier I constructed was immediately crushed by the pressure. Enormous amounts of data flood into my neural cloud, dragging me deeper into the depths of darkness.

spans.text: I only lost my focus for an instant, but the barrier I constructed was immediately crushed by the pressure. Enormous amounts of data flood into my neural cloud, dragging me deeper into the depths of darkness.

units.rawText: When I open up my eyes again, the data around me has shattered into countless reflective shards, mirrors that are all painted with my likeness.
units.displayText: When I open up my eyes again, the data around me has shattered into countless reflective shards, mirrors that are all painted with my likeness.

spans.text: When I open up my eyes again, the data around me has shattered into countless reflective shards, mirrors that are all painted with my likeness.

units.rawText: I move close to the shard and observe carefully. Each shard reflects me in different clothes and expressions, as if they've been individually taken from different times and spaces.
units.displayText: I move close to the shard and observe carefully. Each shard reflects me in different clothes and expressions, as if they've been individually taken from different times and spaces.

spans.text: I move close to the shard and observe carefully. Each shard reflects me in different clothes and expressions, as if they've been individually taken from different times and spaces.

units.rawText: Are all of these... me?
units.displayText: Are all of these... me?

spans.text: Are all of these... me?

units.rawText: The shards do not deign me with an answer. When I begin to hesitate, the shards drag me in.
units.displayText: The shards do not deign me with an answer. When I begin to hesitate, the shards drag me in.

spans.text: The shards do not deign me with an answer. When I begin to hesitate, the shards drag me in.

units.rawText: A droplet squeezed from a dropper, a sliver of dew on a leaf, a pool of water on the battlefield, a drop of oil from a Doll's carcass, a flask of chemicals dropped in a lab...
units.displayText: A droplet squeezed from a dropper, a sliver of dew on a leaf, a pool of water on the battlefield, a drop of oil from a Doll's carcass, a flask of chemicals dropped in a lab...

spans.text: A droplet squeezed from a dropper, a sliver of dew on a leaf, a pool of water on the battlefield, a drop of oil from a Doll's carcass, a flask of chemicals dropped in a lab...

units.rawText: Which one is me? What is "me"?
units.displayText: Which one is me? What is "me"?

spans.text: Which one is me? What is "me"?

units.rawText: You're not supposed to be conscious. You're a tool.
units.displayText: You're not supposed to be conscious. You're a tool.

spans.text: You're not supposed to be conscious. You're a tool.

units.rawText: But I remember I have my duty, I have my wishes...
units.displayText: But I remember I have my duty, I have my wishes...

spans.text: But I remember I have my duty, I have my wishes...

units.rawText: Forget about them. Now, you're but the smallest unit of our collective consciousness. What you should do is to dissolve and become one of us.
units.displayText: Forget about them. Now, you're but the smallest unit of our collective consciousness. What you should do is to dissolve and become one of us.

spans.text: Forget about them. Now, you're but the smallest unit of our collective consciousness. What you should do is to dissolve and become one of us.

units.rawText: No, that's not right. I should remember... I still have things to be done...
units.displayText: No, that's not right. I should remember... I still have things to be done...

spans.text: No, that's not right. I should remember... I still have things to be done...

units.rawText: The voices within my neural cloud are growing louder. The more I deny them, the more the hesitation in my heart grows.
units.displayText: The voices within my neural cloud are growing louder. The more I deny them, the more the hesitation in my heart grows.

spans.text: The voices within my neural cloud are growing louder. The more I deny them, the more the hesitation in my heart grows.

units.rawText: In the end, I can't tell where I'm standing. All that remains is to deny myself who tries to maintain their form, and let the darkness slowly consume me.
units.displayText: In the end, I can't tell where I'm standing. All that remains is to deny myself who tries to maintain their form, and let the darkness slowly consume me.

spans.text: In the end, I can't tell where I'm standing. All that remains is to deny myself who tries to maintain their form, and let the darkness slowly consume me.

units.rawText: ...Sangoma? Sangoma!
units.displayText: ...Sangoma? Sangoma!

spans.text: ...Sangoma? Sangoma!

units.rawText: A droplet of light emerges in front of me, its light dimming the reflections in the mirrors.
units.displayText: A droplet of light emerges in front of me, its light dimming the reflections in the mirrors.

spans.text: A droplet of light emerges in front of me, its light dimming the reflections in the mirrors.

units.rawText: Yes. I... I am Sangoma.
units.displayText: Yes. I... I am Sangoma.

spans.text: Yes. I... I am Sangoma.

units.rawText: I regain my bearings, putting my gaze into the figure beside me.
units.displayText: I regain my bearings, putting my gaze into the figure beside me.

spans.text: I regain my bearings, putting my gaze into the figure beside me.

units.rawText: <cmdr>?! How did you wake up?
units.displayText: {교수}?! How did you wake up?

spans.text: ?! How did you wake up?

units.rawText: Probably because I received your protection. I didn't expect you to connect to the system too...
units.displayText: Probably because I received your protection. I didn't expect you to connect to the system too...

spans.text: Probably because I received your protection. I didn't expect you to connect to the system too...

units.rawText: Nonetheless, it's not time for this. We need to suppress the data storm.
units.displayText: Nonetheless, it's not time for this. We need to suppress the data storm.

spans.text: Nonetheless, it's not time for this. We need to suppress the data storm.

units.rawText: If one cannot handle the data streams alone, then it'll just have to take the two of us.
units.displayText: If one cannot handle the data streams alone, then it'll just have to take the two of us.

spans.text: If one cannot handle the data streams alone, then it'll just have to take the two of us.

units.rawText: Sangoma, will you help me?
units.displayText: Sangoma, will you help me?

spans.text: Sangoma, will you help me?

units.rawText: Of course! I'm glad to be at your side.
units.displayText: Of course! I'm glad to be at your side.

spans.text: Of course! I'm glad to be at your side.

units.rawText: We hold hands with fingers interlaced; a warm light rises from the dark abyss, resisting the darkness together.
units.displayText: We hold hands with fingers interlaced; a warm light rises from the dark abyss, resisting the darkness together.

spans.text: We hold hands with fingers interlaced; a warm light rises from the dark abyss, resisting the darkness together.

units.rawText: Within the whirlwind, <cmdr> almost completely loses their own form, but their hand still holds me tightly.
units.displayText: Within the whirlwind, {교수} almost completely loses their own form, but their hand still holds me tightly.

spans.text: Within the whirlwind,
almost completely loses their own form, but their hand still holds me tightly.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, you can rely on me! Your consciousness...
units.displayText: {교수}, you can rely on me! Your consciousness...

spans.text: , you can rely on me! Your consciousness...

units.rawText: No worries. We'll be fine.
units.displayText: No worries. We'll be fine.

spans.text: No worries. We'll be fine.

units.rawText: I have a lot I want to ask you after everything ends.
units.displayText: I have a lot I want to ask you after everything ends.

spans.text: I have a lot I want to ask you after everything ends.

units.rawText: I don't know your objectives or who your "Boss" is... Moreover, I still don't know what kind of a Doll you are when the mask is off.
units.displayText: I don't know your objectives or who your "Boss" is... Moreover, I still don't know what kind of a Doll you are when the mask is off.

spans.text: I don't know your objectives or who your "Boss" is... Moreover, I still don't know what kind of a Doll you are when the mask is off.

units.rawText: Their neural cloud operates at an increased rate, brute forcing the suppression of the data storm with their human body.
units.displayText: Their neural cloud operates at an increased rate, brute forcing the suppression of the data storm with their human body.

spans.text: Their neural cloud operates at an increased rate, brute forcing the suppression of the data storm with their human body.

units.rawText: <size=32>Let's go back, Sangoma! Let's go back to the Oasis we built together!</size>
units.displayText: Let's go back, Sangoma! Let's go back to the Oasis we built together!

spans.text: Let's go back, Sangoma! Let's go back to the Oasis we built together!
